elections.title: Student Government Elections 2025
elections.description: Annual student government elections to select representatives for the academic year 2025-2026. Vote for your preferred candidates who will represent your voice in school matters.

positions.title: Student Body President
positions.description: The highest student leadership position, representing all students in school governance and decision-making.

candidates.name: Maria Santos
candidates.platform: Improving student facilities, enhancing academic support programs, and promoting environmental sustainability initiatives throughout the campus.
candidates.experience: Current Class President, Member of Student Council for 2 years, Debate Team Captain

candidates.name: Miguel Torres
candidates.platform: Advancing technology integration in learning, establishing peer tutoring programs, and creating more opportunities for student innovation and creativity.
candidates.experience: Robotics Club President, Science Fair Champion, Student Council Treasurer

positions.title: Vice President
positions.description: Second-in-command who assists the president and leads specific student initiatives and committees.

candidates.name: Ana Rodriguez
candidates.platform: Strengthening student voice in academic policies, improving communication between students and faculty, and promoting arts and cultural programs.
candidates.experience: School Newspaper Editor-in-Chief, Drama Club President, Honor Society Member

candidates.name: Carlos Mendoza
candidates.platform: Enhancing sports and recreational facilities, promoting student wellness programs, and fostering school spirit through various activities.
candidates.experience: Basketball Team Captain, Sports Committee Head, Peer Mediator

positions.title: Secretary
positions.description: Responsible for maintaining records, communications, and coordinating student government activities.

candidates.name: Sofia Garcia
candidates.platform: Improving student information systems, organizing efficient record-keeping, and ensuring transparent communication of student government activities.
candidates.experience: Class Secretary for 3 years, Event Coordinator, Student Volunteer Program Leader

positions.title: Treasurer
positions.description: Manages student government finances and oversees budget allocation for student activities and projects.

candidates.name: Isabella Cruz
candidates.platform: Ensuring transparent financial management, maximizing budget efficiency for student programs, and establishing fundraising initiatives for school improvements.
candidates.experience: Art Club Treasurer, Fundraising Committee Member, Math Olympiad Participant

candidates.name: Rafael Lopez
candidates.platform: Implementing digital financial tracking systems, promoting cost-effective student activities, and ensuring equitable budget distribution across all grade levels.
candidates.experience: Class Treasurer, Computer Club Member, Academic Excellence Awardee
